traits.name: Resistance
traits.desc: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

traits.name: Legacy Cantrip
traits.desc: You know the Fire Bolt cantrip (Charisma).

traits.name: Level 1 Spell
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you always have Hellish Rebuke prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot (or with a slot).

traits.name: Level 2 Spell
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, you always have Darkness prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot (or with a slot).
